items.title: The AlgoMaster Mobile App Is Here!
items.author: Ashish Pratap Singh
items.content:
I’m excited to launch the for both.

You can now access content on your phone and learn DSA, System Design, Low-Level Design, AI Engineering, and other interview topics anytime, anywhere.

The mobile app makes it easier to continue learning during your commute, revise concepts before an interview, or study whenever you are away from your computer.

Inside the app, you can access:

  • 15+ structured courses on DSA, System Design, LLD, AI Engineering, and more

  • 1,000+ interactive animations that explain complex concepts visually

  • Step-by-step explanations of popular interview problems

  • Quizzes and hands-on exercises

  • Listen mode for learning on the go

  • A growing collection of videos and more learning resources

If you are currently on the free plan and would like to , we recommend purchasing Premium through the website, where the prices are lower.

You do not need to create a separate account for the mobile app.

Simply sign in using the same email address you use on , and your account and Premium access will work across the website, Android app, and iOS app.

Since this is our initial release, your feedback will be extremely valuable.

If you find the app helpful, please consider leaving a rating and review on the Play Store or App Store. It helps more learners discover AlgoMaster.

Please reply to this email if you notice any issues or have suggestions for features you would like to see in future updates.

A special thank you to , who deserves all the credit for helping me build and launch the mobile app in a short time.

We plan to keep improving the experience, fixing issues, and adding new features that make it easier to learn and practice technical concepts from anywhere.

Thank you for being part of the AlgoMaster community.

Happy learning,Founder, AlgoMaster
